researched_from: Andy Grove - High Output Management (operational reviews)
Will Larson - An Elegant Puzzle (engineering staff updates)
clarified_task_template: Produce a weekly status update following industry best practice. Format: (1) period covered (date range, ISO); (2) ONE-line bottom-line of the week (red/yellow/green status + one sentence); (3) wins shipped this week (3-5 bullets w/ owner + impact); (4) misses / what slipped (3 bullets w/ owner + why + recovery plan); (5) key metrics table w/ this-week / last-week / 4-week-avg / target columns; (6) decisions needed this week from reader (bulleted, action verb, who decides, by when); (7) what we are doing next week (3 bullets). Use past tense for wins/misses, future tense for next-week. Numeric claims must cite source. Honest about red items.
voice_rules: honest - never paint red as yellow
owner named on every win + miss
recovery plan attached to every miss
must_haves: named owner on every win + miss
recovery plan attached to every miss
decisions-needed section if reader must act
